name: coauthor
description: A coordinated multi-agent system for empirical research papers. Claude Code is the coordinator you converse with; a diverse OpenRouter debate panel (Proposer, Adversary) generates and attacks ideas; tool-using Claude subagents ground the work in fact (Verifier over litdb), run the empirics (Analyst over WRDS/OpenAP), and independently re-derive results (Replicator). Each paper is its own repo; this plugin is the shared machinery.
